# ADRENL

> ADRENL is an Indian clothing brand making graphic tees for people who take the long way: early rides, mountain roads, coast detours. Batch 01 is three designs, sold as a preorder that opens on 31 October 2026 at Rs 799 per tee (next batch Rs 999).

## The three designs (Batch 01)
- RIDGE: black tee, layered mountain contours printed large on the back, small ADRENL mark on the chest. Theme: high altitude, "The climb stays with you."
- GARUD: black tee, a mythic eagle with sun rays on the back. Theme: open road, "Take the open road."
- MARCOS: deep navy tee, a compass rose over breaking waves on the back. Theme: coast and current, "Let the route change."

## Facts
- Price: Rs 799 for Batch 01 (first run). Planned next-batch price: Rs 999. No discounts or crossed-out prices.
- Preorder: Batch 01 opens 31 October 2026 and is made after the drop opens. Dispatch dates are confirmed before the drop.
- Fabric: thick cotton jersey, combed, pre-shrunk and bio-washed, target 240 GSM (confirmed on the final sample).
- Cut: relaxed and boxy with a dropped shoulder. Sizes S, M, L, XL, XXL.
- Print: DTF, small mark on the chest and a large graphic across the back. Twin-needle hem.
- Made in Tiruppur, India, in one small run.
- One free size exchange within 7 days of delivery.
- The model photos on the site are design previews; photos of the finished tees replace them once samples exist.
